author: Swiggy
text: 22h #Swiggy and Instamart hosted the EV Mobility Conclave, themed "Powering the Last Mile," in the presence of Hon'ble Union Minister Shri Nitin Gadkari, bringing together EV manufacturers, charging and battery-swapping providers, rental and fleet partners, financiers and delivery partners towards one shared goal: Making electric two-wheelers a practical and affordable choice for last-mile delivery. At the event, Swiggy launched battery swapping stations at its Instamart pods across 25 locations, developed together with ecosystem partners. Swiggy is also bringing EV rentals to its Instamart pods, so that delivery partners can pick up a vehicle at the same place where they collect their orders. On a busy day, a delivery partner visits a pod about 20 times. Placing battery swapping and EV rentals at the pods brings these services seamlessly into their workspace. Sriharsha M., Co-founder and Group CEO, shared, "When a solution is built around the partner's day rather than around the technology, adoption becomes a natural choice. That is the future we want to help build for the people who power India's last mile." At the Conclave, delivery partners who have been leading EV adoption were recognised, alongside ecosystem enablers. Swiggy is committed to building an EV ecosystem that works for the people at the centre of it. Baaz Bikes | BGAUSS | Bounce Daily | Hala Mobility | Indofast Energy | Motovolt Mobility | RIDEV | Shadowfax | Veelo Mobility | Yulu | Yuma Energy #Swiggy #Swigg

author: drmaryclaire
text:
Women deserve to know what menopause can change about their vulva, vagina, and urinary health.

✨Comment POD and I’ll send you the link to our unPAUSED episode on genitourinary syndrome of menopause (GSM).

Understanding your anatomy can help you recognize changes and explain what you’re experiencing. But too many women have never been taught what to look for, what questions to ask, or that help is available.

This is why I keep having these conversations. You deserve to understand your own body and feel comfortable asking for care.

#menopause #gsm #womenshealth #midlife #healthcare
